page: Amazon Web Services m7gd.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the ARM64 architecture, this server features 8 dedicated physical cores utilizing the ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 microarchitecture running at 2.6 GHz. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance is integrated with the AWS Nitro hypervisor and includes 474 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

In terms of performance, the m7gd.2xlarge demonstrates strong memory capabilities, highlighted by a Passmark memory score in the top 25% and a cached small-block read bandwidth of 775.64 GB/sec. CPU performance is generally moderate, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling in the middle 50% range. However, certain workloads reveal performance tradeoffs, such as weak Passmark CPU encryption and weak multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, which falls into the bottom 25%.

The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring rapid local data access without the overhead of network-attached storage. It is well-suited for applications such as database operations, static web serving, and general-purpose containerized workloads, though it may underperform in heavy cryptographic or complex decompression tasks.
